intro: You do not need to be a member to book. Tell us the date and what you're planning, and we'll tell you whether the space works for it.

whatItIs.headline: A gallery, an event & workshop space and an auditorium.
whatItIs.body: ODDspace is a working creative space in Vallila with several bookable event spaces: the Gallery, Aula, Event & workshop space and Auditorium. Exhibitions, launches, workshops, talks, screenings, shoots, gatherings and performances have all happened here. It is more raw and flexible than a conventional conference venue.

spacesIntro.headline: Choose the space that fits your event.

spaces.name: Gallery
spaces.body: The big room at street level — a raised, curved floor where most evening events take place. Openings, receptions, launches, concerts, club nights and performances. Its walls are usually hung with work, so tell us early if you need them clear.
bullets: Member rate: €200 for a full day

spaces.name: Event & workshop space
spaces.body: One floor up, and closer to a living room than a venue: sofas, big black speakers and daylight from the windows. It works especially well for day-long programmes, workshops and smaller gatherings.
bullets: Up to 150 people, on the 2nd floor

spaces.name: Auditorium
spaces.body: Tiered seating for talks, panels, screenings, presentations and smaller events. Fixed seating keeps the focus forward without adding a stage.
bullets: Member rate: €100 for a half day

spaces.name: ODDstudio
spaces.body: The creative music studio, run with TUNEMENT. Booked separately from the event rooms — useful alongside an event for recording, podcasts or live sessions.
bullets: Genelec monitoring and a mic locker
From €20 / hour for members, from €30 / hour without

pricing.headline: Choose your booking type to see a starting price.
pricing.body: Prices depend on the type of organiser and booking. Choose the closest fit for a starting price, then tell us what you're planning and we'll quote the actual event.

memberRates.name: ODDstudio, per hour
memberRates.note: The studio is booked separately from the event rooms. Full rates are on the ODDstudio page.

ratesNote: All prices are + VAT 25.5%, with setup and teardown included within your booked hours. Cleaning, catering, bar licensing and rigging are either arranged by you or quoted separately.

whatWeCanDo.headline: Need more than a venue?
whatWeCanDo.body: The team behind ODDspace also develops and produces events, programmes and creative projects. If you need help with the concept, programme, production or bringing the right people together, tell us in your enquiry. We can help with those too — or simply give you the room and let you run with it.

howItWorks.title: Tell us the date and the idea
howItWorks.body: What you're planning, the date or dates, roughly how many people, and what you need the room to do.

howItWorks.title: We reply with availability and a price
howItWorks.body: Whether the date is free, which room fits, what the space can and cannot do for that plan, and what it costs.

howItWorks.title: We confirm it in writing
howItWorks.body: Times, access, setup and what's included, agreed before anything is booked in.

availability.headline: Is your date free?
availability.note: Booked rooms straight from our calendar, updated as bookings come in. Red means booked. A room that is not shown on a day is free. Times are Helsinki time.

askUs.headline: Details we confirm for your event.
askUs.body: Tell us what you're planning and when. We'll confirm the relevant capacities, technical setup, access, availability and anything else you need to know for your event.

beforeYourEvent.body: Read the event info pack and code of conduct before the day.

faq.question: Do I need to be a member to book?
faq.answer: No. Renting the gallery or the auditorium doesn't require a membership. Plan your event with the form and we price it.

faq.question: What does it cost?
faq.answer: Members pay €100 for a half day and €200 for a full day. A creative organisation or a promoter pays €300 for the room, or nothing upfront on a revenue share where the first €350 of net ticket sales covers it. Companies and other organisations pay €750 for a half day and €1,200 for a full day or evening. All + VAT 25.5%, a house technician is €200 where you need one, and the calculator above gives you a starting number for your own case. Final pricing may vary depending on the hours, setup and production needs of the event.

faq.question: How many people fit?
faq.answer: Capacity depends on the room and layout. Tell us the date and type of event and we'll confirm the right number for your format.

faq.question: What AV and technical equipment is there?
faq.answer: Tell us your technical plan and we'll confirm what is available in the building, what we can bring in and what you need to bring yourself.

faq.question: Is the space accessible?
faq.answer: We are still verifying the building's accessibility details. If accessibility affects your event, email hello@oddfest.co before booking and we will confirm the current route, lifts and toilets.

faq.question: Can I bring my own caterer, DJ or production team?
faq.answer: Usually yes — tell us who and what in the enquiry so we can check it against the building's own rules and confirm it with you before you book anyone.

faq.question: Can ODD help produce the event, not just rent the room?
faq.answer: Yes. Tell us what you have in mind and we'll explain what we could take on and what that would cost.

faq.question: Can we record the event?
faq.answer: ODDstudio is in the same building and is booked separately — from €20 / hour for members and from €30 / hour without. Say so in your enquiry and we'll line the two bookings up.

faq.question: How far ahead should I ask?
faq.answer: As early as you can — the space is in daily use and popular dates go first. If your date is soon, ask anyway; sometimes it works.

finalCta.headline: Plan your event at ODDspace.
finalCta.body: Tell us when, roughly how many people and what you're planning. We check the date and reply with availability and a price.

lanes.name: Creative organisation
lanes.blurb: A registered association, an artist collective, a curator, an artist, a promoter with a gig or a club night. Ticketed or free.

rates.label: Revenue share
rates.note: Nothing upfront. The first €350 of net ticket sales covers the room, and most of what comes after that is yours — we agree the split when we agree the night.

addOns.label: House technician
addOns.note: Required on the house PA unless your own engineer is approved in advance.

lanes.name: Company or organisation
lanes.blurb: A launch, a workshop, an away-day, a party. Room, staff and cleaning handled.

rates.label: Full day or evening, up to 10 hours

rateCard.note: Every number here is a starting point, not a till receipt. We talk each event through — the room, the hours, the help you want — and price that. If your event is for a cause and the budget is not there, say so; we would rather hear it early.
